messages:
support-liaison: Heads-up — AcmeMaps is escalating: p99 has regressed from ~3.2s to ~9.8s during their billing window. They're also seeing intermittent 5xx errors. Link to customer logs: https://redwood.cust/ACME/logs/ee3d

olivia: Copy. Which Dedicated pool is this hitting? Any recent kernel/model deploys to that pool?

infra-bot: Incident created INC-3482: "dedicated-pool eu-west-3-dedicated-42 high-p99-latency" (auto-alert from latency-detector)

mike: I'm seeing scale-up queue length spike for pool eu-west-3-dedicated-42. Attach latency: p95 ~120s, p99 ~400s. Repro from telemetry: a lot of `image pull` errors then fallback to cold GPU start path.

raj: Repro steps I ran on staging:
1) queue 20 concurrent attach requests to pool
2) force model cache miss (delete /var/cache/models/model-x)
3) observe attach times >200s when kernel image must be pulled

Minimal repro curl: ```
curl -X POST https://inference.redwood/devices/attach -d '{"model":"model-x","tenant":"acmemaps"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```

olivia: Thanks. Sounds like two contributing issues: (A) kernel image pulls slow / registry throttling, (B) model cache init + quantized weight load causing long warmup. Quick mitigations we can try: set pool.min_warm_replicas=2 for acmemaps reserved pool, and temporarily bump attach concurrency to 3. Also lower autoscaler down-cooldown to allow faster re-attaches. Can infra apply those immediately? @mike @raj

mike: I can hotpatch autoscaler policy for that pool — reducing cooldown and adding an early-start condition when queue_length > 4. Applying to staging first.

deploy-bot: Deployed autoscaler hotfix (hotfix/autoscaler-earlystart) to staging at 2026-03-17T09:15Z.

sre-oncall: Another short-term option: route AcmeMaps traffic to their hosted fallback model-variant (smaller model) until we stabilize warmup. That keeps customer SLOs while we fix infra.

support-liaison: Noted. I've told the customer we have a mitigation in place and we're rolling a hotfix; they want ETA for full fix and whether this will happen next billing window.

olivia: Root cause analysis so far: kernel image pulls are increasing cold-start attach latency due to (1) registry rate-limits and (2) image layers not cached on newer nodes. Separately model artifact cache TTL is too short for low-traffic tenants, causing frequent cache misses during burst windows. Plan: prefetch kernel images onto pool nodes, bump model cache TTL and pool.min_warm_replicas, and add a prewarm job triggered by queue depth.

raj: I opened PR #1234 that adds a prefetcher daemonset (node-level) + prewarm controller that kicks when queue_length > 3 for priority tenants. Also increases model cache retention for reserved pools. Rolling canary now.

mike: Canary results: p99 for canary tenants dropped from ~9.8s -> 3.1s. Attach error rate also fell. Metrics: attach_failures down 78%, kernel-pull retries down 90%.

support-liaison: Customer reports "noticeable improvement, occasional spikes remain" — they're appreciative but want the long-term mitigation and cost plan.

olivia: Next steps:
- Promote prefetcher + prewarm to prod for dedicated eu-west-3 this evening (post-maintenance window).
- Schedule a capacity bump (reserved GPUs) for AcmeMaps for next billing cycle (CC finance).
- Add a guardrail: if queue_length spikes during billing window, auto-increase min_warm_replicas for priority tenants.

deploy-bot: Rolled canary -> prod for prefetcher in eu-west-3 at 2026-03-17T11:02Z.

mike: Monitoring lines look good. p99 is stable ~3.0-3.5s for the affected pool; occasional single-attach spikes traceable to upstream S3 fetch timeouts for a specific shard.

olivia: I'll follow up with a short postmortem and assign action items (PR link, runbooks, billing note). For now we keep this thread open until next billing window passes. :eyes:

support-liaison: I've updated the customer and created a support ticket with the remediation timeline. They asked for a postmortem when done.

sre-oncall: Suggested long-term: add image registry caching at region-edge and make prefetcher part of pool bootstrap. Also document timeout increase for model downloads vs attach timeout.

olivia: Agreed. Assigning owners in the PM tracker. Closing the immediate escalation — will reopen if we see regressions. :thumbsup:
